incorrect_claim: The conditional dispatch at 0x800063C0 targeted 0x804B9E94, an unregistered interior address.
cause: Arithmetic error in hexadecimal subtraction. 0x804C0000 - 24932 equals 0x804B9E9C, not 0x804B9E94.
ghidra_decompilation: __start resolves the conditional indirect call as InitMetroTRK.
consequence: The isolated 0x804B9E94 translation/build was unrelated to the boot target and has been removed from the active plan. It must not be cited as resolving a startup gap.
